Name: Venue Audio
Author: NoctusDev
Punchline: Broadcast your PC audio and listen together, inside FFXIV.
Description: Broadcast a PC audio output or mixer, optionally add your microphone, and listen together inside FFXIV. Automatic temporary internet hosting lets friends join from other networks using a guest invite. Audio is encrypted before entering the relay. Open using the plugin settings button or /venueaudio. Early test build; the temporary hosting address changes each broadcast.
